name: Clay vase workshop
blurb: Hand-build a vase about 15 × 12 cm with texture and pressed shapes. Cate fires and glazes it in your choice of colour, watertight for flowers. All materials and two firings included. Upstairs, no lift.

name: Creative cup clay workshop
blurb: Hand-build and decorate a cup about 8 × 9 cm from templates. Cate glazes and fires it, ready about four weeks later. Materials, glaze and two firings included.

name: Gin and Clay: magical blue tile workshop
blurb: Make a clay tile, fired and glazed in vibrant blue, with a tasting tray of three gins from The Bond Store. Materials, glaze and two firings included.
